ಎಜಾನ
Children be cautious !!! Be alert
Your body belongs only to you, You have all the rights
to keep safe and protect it always.
Safe and Unsafe touches on your body.
See the picture and understand
this cautious is for Boys and Girls
Forehead
Cheeks
Lips
Shoulder!
Back
Chest
Hand
Bottom
Bbelow your back 
Part between
two legs
Unsafe Touch eap fouch - parts of your body where nobody should touch
Jexcept parents and in their presence only doctors can touch
Safe touch goop fouch -can touch only when required 
When you feel Unsafe Touch or any other mischief, please Say loudly
NO.. Don't. Stop it.and Scream, push the person aside and move to a safer place,
be brave and inform about it, to your parents 8 Trusted adult and register a complaint 
Published by Distict Administration -08532-29011, Zilla Panchyat-228448
Department of Police -2535/ 25001 I 235100 I 100 1091 District Child Protection Unit-280670, 
Department of Women and Child Develpoment-22622, Unicef Child Protection Project 23060. Raichur 
Be Smart, Be Safe, Be Happy
unicef
